name: Processor B (9q, dense K5-minus-2 core + sparse tail)
design_rationale: Co-designed for this problem: the knapsack cost Hamiltonian couples every pair of items (w_i*w_j terms => K5). Qubits 0-3 form a K4 and qubit 4 couples to 1 and 2, so 8 of the 10 required ZZ pairs are native. Qubits 5-8 form a sparse tail that remains available for larger encodings. This experiment routes the same five-item QAOA circuit on A and B; the dense core preserves most of its K5 cost-layer couplings while the tail is unused.
